outcome: maternal adverse outcomes (prenatal pyrexia, postpartum hemorrhage, maternal intensive care unit admission, prethrombotic state)

neonatal adverse outcomes (premature delivery, intrauterine fetal death or induction of labor, fetal macrosomia, fetal growth restriction, small-for-gestational age, fetal abnormalities, neonatal intensive care unit admission, birth asphyxia)
cohort: The study included 845 pregnant women from a tertiary hospital in Hubei, China, comparing pregnancy outcomes between vaccinated and unvaccinated participants.
finding: No significant difference was found in composite adverse pregnancy outcomes between vaccinated and unvaccinated participants, even when vaccination occurred during early pregnancy.
